HPTN_083.notes: HPTN 083 (cabotegravir-LA in MSM/TGW) efficacy result is cited verbatim in the Background: 'long-acting PrEP with cabotegravir administered as a bi-monthly injection was found to be 89% more effective than oral PrEP at preventing HIV acquisition.' This sentence references HPTN 083/084 combined result but the trial name HPTN 083 is not stated verbatim — it appears only as a numbered citation. The body includes 'four studies each on long-acting injectable PrEP' as economic evaluations. Bozzani search date is August 2020; HPTN 083 results (NEJM November 2021) postdate the search. Background reference is to interim/preliminary data available at time of writing. Layer-M booleans all FALSE (no verbatim trial-name quote). PMC full text available (PMC10085926).
